statement: d-Matrix will integrate its Raptor inference XPUs into NVIDIA's MGX rackscale architecture using NVLink Fusion, with tape-out expected before year-end 2026 and initial availability in Q4 2027.
why: A credible non-GPU inference accelerator entering NVIDIA's own rack ecosystem widens the pool of accelerators that can serve inference workloads.

impact.mechanism: Alternative inference silicon slotting into standard racks adds non-GPU capacity for inference while still pulling NVIDIA CPUs, DPUs, switches and Ethernet fabric into the same systems.

evidence.excerpt: Expected tape-out before year-end 2026; initial availability Q4 2027.
features innovative 3D DRAM stacking combining a DRAM chip and SRAM compute chip in a single package

confidence.basis: Vendor press release fetched at secondary tier; availability is more than a year out and no shipped volumes exist.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend falling -> rising); sources: d-matrix.ai, thestar.com.my
